metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill addressing Jetty-specific Servlet API downgrading for Spring Boot 3.0 migration. It does not semantically overlap with existing skills (cache queue sizing, buffer timeout configuration) or peer candidates (trailing slash matching, HTTP header migration, Maven plugin deprecation). The peer candidates address different Spring Boot 3.0 migration concerns (URL routing, header properties, build config) and do not subsume or conflict with this Jetty/Servlet version workaround. No merge, split, or revision relationship exists.
